sloka: चकार आवाहनम् तत्र भाग अर्थम् सर्व देवताः ।न अभ्यागमन् तदा भाग अर्थम् सर्व देवताः ॥१-६०-११॥
transliteration: cakāra āvāhanam tatra bhāga artham sarva devatāḥ ।na abhyāgaman tadā bhāga artham sarva devatāḥ ॥1-60-11॥

translations.english: When, the gods invited by him did not come to receive their share of offerings, the great ascetic Viswamitra seized with anger lifted the sacrificial ladle and said to Trisanku:
